name: Orbit Gallery
description: A framework-free Web Component that stands pictures on a 3D ring: it drifts on its own, stops under the pointer, and singles out whichever picture you drag round to the front.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Eight pictures drifting on one ring, stopping under the pointer and answering the keyboard.

variants.name: Density
variants.description: Five, eight, and twelve pictures on the same element, with the radius worked out from the count.

variants.name: Drag
variants.description: Turning the ring by hand: how a drag maps to degrees, how a throw coasts, and what no-drag takes away.

variants.name: Speed
variants.description: How fast the ring drifts and which way round it goes, from a slow minute to ten seconds a turn.

variants.name: States
variants.description: A ring held still, a picture that never arrived, a single picture, and reduced motion.
